data.name: Hoorah
data.gender_notes: Hoorah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Hawr', meaning 'a lake'. In Islamic context, Hoorah symbolizes the radiant and glorious paradise that awaits the believers after death. The name Hoorah carries the meaning “Glorious, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hoorah usually hope their child will grow to embody glorious, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with spiritual significance, representing the radiant and glorious paradise that awaits the faithful.
data.etymology: Hoorah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glorious, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hoorah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
